learning.title: Research intake must deduplicate pending candidates and refuse same-day overwrites
learning.claim: A date-scoped research intake filename can collide across same-day feed changes; Python open mode 'x' refuses to overwrite an existing file. Pending-title dedup, exclusive creation, and immediate JSON read-back preserve unreviewed candidates, while collisions must fail closed.
learning.decision: RESEARCH_INTAKE_EXCLUSIVE_CREATE_GATE: Check canonical ledger and valid pending staged titles before creating a new research candidate. Use exclusive file creation rather than truncating a date-based path, fail closed on changed-headline filename collisions, verify JSON read-back, and preserve the prior candidate. Keep promotion pending until PR-head tests and main integration are verified.
learning.next_measurement: On existing PR #326, confirm identical feed re-run is already_staged, different same-day headline returns staging_collision without modifying prior bytes, CodeQL and PR gate succeed on latest SHA, and main read-back proves integration. No PayoutLens changes.
failure_history: 2026-10-24: existing research_learner used write_json on YYYY-MM-DD-research-learner-<plan>.json; changed same-day feed could truncate an unreviewed staged candidate. Code and tests exist only on draft PR #326.
fallback_history: If exclusive creation is blocked or the path already exists, retain the old file, record staging_collision, and request review instead of overwriting or bypassing permissions.
